sloka: तेषु वानरमुख्येषु दीप्तोल्कोज्ज्वलपाणिषु।स्थितेषु द्वारमासाद्य रावणं मन्युराविशत् ।। ६.७५.४३ ।।
transliteration: teṣu vānaramukhyeṣu dīptolkojjvalapāṇiṣu।sthiteṣu dvāramāsādya rāvaṇaṁ manyurāviśat ।। 6.75.43 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva the great king of Vanaras commanded all the bulls among Vanaras, to encounter after reaching the gate of Lanka. "He who is staying wherever they are does not obey the king's command will be killed for being guilty of flouting the command", ordered Sugriva to the Vanaras.
translations.hindi: उस थप्पड़ की चोट से सहातेजस्वी त्रिशिरा के गाथ से आयुध छूट पड़ा और बह स्त्र्यं भी भूछित हो, भूमि पर गिर पड़ा
